metadata.description: Tau Hosted Remote in real processes (W18, W8): stock git and git-lfs against the built API on :4014 and a second process of the same build on :4016, sharing one Postgres and one MinIO and no disk — the deployed shape, and the proof of S2 across operating-system processes. The CLI build, Docker and db-migrate run ahead of vitest, the same split desktop-e2e uses. No `dependsOn` on `api:build`: that chain reaches `runtime:build`, which is red on Node 24 for a tsdown config-loader bug, so the global setup runs `vite build` in apps/api itself — the same choice desktop-e2e made and documented.

commands: docker-compose -f ../../infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis minio minio-bootstrap
